=== KEY DECISION: THE RATING ORDER-ID LINCHPIN (advisor-confirmed) ===
POST orders/{id}/rating (A-rating) is CustomerOnly and needs the order id, but NEITHER the by-code tracking DTO (no id/price, verified TrackOrderResponse) NOR getMyActiveOrder (Completed is terminal -> excluded from active, returns null) carries an id for a Completed order. SOURCE OF TRUTH CHOSEN: GET orders/mine (A-my-orders history list), matched on publicCode. This one lookup solves THREE needs: (a) the order id for the POST, (b) already-rated detection (MyOrderListItemDto.RatingStars != null, verified the backend projects it), (c) cache reuse with B-history (same query). Strictly better than threading the id via router state from B-history because it covers ALL entry points (live completion, history tap, direct /c/t/:code URL), not just the history tap. useRateOrder(publicCode) reads ['orders','mine','list',1] and finds row.publicCode===code.

=== CANONICAL MINE-LIST QUERY KEY ===
Defined here (B-rating built first): ['orders','mine','list', page] (getMyOrderHistory(1,20)). B-history's useMyOrderHistory reuses the SAME key so the rating resolver and the history list share one cache. On a successful rating POST, useRateOrder invalidates ['orders','mine','list'] (+ ['orders','detail',id]) so history reflects the new rating. Both hooks gate on authStorage token (mirror useMyActiveOrder) to avoid a logged-out 401->silentRefresh->/c/login redirect.

=== RATING SLOT WIRING (no tracking-screen refactor, per task) ===
TrackingPage passes ratingSlot={<RatingForm publicCode={code}/>} to StatusHeadline ONLY when mode==='authed' && descriptor.showRating (Completed). A logged-out public viewer on a Completed order falls back to the existing default seam text ('Ohodnoťte prosím svoji jízdu.') — never a functional form (the POST is CustomerOnly, no id/auth in public mode). The laneB4d ratingSlot seam (StatusHeadline optional ratingSlot prop, rendered on descriptor.showRating) was used exactly as designed — StatusHeadline.tsx/headlineRules.ts/TrackingPage structure NOT refactored, only the slot content + the one ratingSlot line added.

=== ONCE-PER-ORDER / 409 HANDLING (ratingRules.ts pure) ===
resolveRatingView({existingStars, submitted, submittedStars}): existingStars!=null (from orders/mine) -> read-only thanks BEFORE the form ever shows; a local 204 success -> thanks (204 has NO body, so thanks is driven by local state + the submitted stars, not a refetch); a 409 on submit (already rated server-side, race) -> treated as already-rated (converge on thanks, errorKey stays null), NOT a crash. Any non-409 failure -> stay on form + customer.rating.submitFailed. Both 409 branches = Order.AlreadyRated and Order.NotCompleted map to 409; for a Completed order being rated, NotCompleted is unreachable, so treating 409 as already-rated is safe.

=== EXACT RATING REQUEST SHAPE USED ===
POST /orders/{id}/rating body = { stars: number (1..5), comment: string|null } -> 204 No Content (verified against RateOrderEndpoint.cs + RateOrderRequest.cs). client.ts rateOrder(orderId, {stars, comment}) returns Promise<void> (apiRequest already returns undefined on 204). Comment is trimmed; empty/whitespace -> null. Added RateOrderRequest type to client.ts. Also extended the frontend OrderDetailDto with optional ratingStars/ratingComment/ratedAt (A-rating added them to the backend OrderDetailDto; the frontend type was missing them).

=== STARPICKER (native radios, axe-clean) ===
fieldset/legend radiogroup of native <input type=radio> (visually hidden but focusable) wrapped in star-glyph labels — keyboard arrow-nav, aria-checked and the axe pass come for free (web-accessibility.md 'native elements first'). Each star label is a >=48px touch target. aria-label per star 'Hodnotit {{stars}} hvězdičkami'. A readOnly mode renders plain filled/empty star glyphs (no inputs) for the thanks state, labelled 'Vaše hodnocení: {{stars}} z 5'.

=== B-HISTORY ===
useMyOrderHistory -> GET orders/mine page 1 (['orders','mine','list',1], token-gated). CustomerHistoryPage (route /c/history added under /c in router.tsx; /x and /d untouched) renders HistoryRow cards: date (Europe/Prague), route 'pickup -> dropoff', price (formatCzk cs-CZ: final->fixed->'—'), status pill (historyStatusKey). Plain .map (a customer's own rides are realistically small — NO virtualization per web-performance.md). Empty list -> 'Zatím žádné jízdy'. Offline -> role=status banner + last-known cached rows (reads keep working, never blank). historyRules.ts (pure: isHistoryEmpty, historyRowPriceCzk, historyStatusKey, historyRowTimestamp) + reorder.ts (pure: buildReorderDraft, REORDER_STATE_KEY) are the decision modules.

=== HISTORY ROW NAV + OBJEDNAT ZNOVU ===
Each row = an <article> containing a react-router <Link> to /c/t/{publicCode} (read-only tracking — the laneB4d cold-authed-terminal contract note: a terminal order has no active order so orderId is null, no Subscribe, the by-code DTO renders read-only) PLUS a separate 'Objednat znovu' <button> (NOT nested in the link — valid a11y). The link has aria-label 'Zobrazit jízdu {{code}}'. Objednat znovu -> navigate('/c/order/new', { state: { reorder: buildReorderDraft(order) } }). CustomOrderPage reads location.state.reorder and prefills the pickup/dropoff ADDRESS fields only (the history list projection has no fresh coords); the customer re-confirms pickup on the map/autocomplete which supplies lat/lng before submit is enabled (existing canSubmit gate requires coords). No coords are invented.

=== SCOPE CHECK: NO /x WORK ===
The designer's B-rating WI scopes NO dispatcher display task — the dispatcher rating view is the backend A-rating change (OrderDetailDto + GetOrderEndpoint, already merged). Left /x untouched (confirmed against the B-rating acceptance_criteria: only rateOrder/StarPicker/ratingForm + parity).

=== NO NEW TRAPS; EXISTING TRAPS AVOIDED ===
- Windows case-collision: used ratingRules.ts (NOT the designer's ratingForm.ts, which would collide with RatingForm.tsx on case-insensitive FS — same trap as whenRules/headlineRules). historyRules.ts + reorder.ts have no .tsx twin (safe).
- i18n aria-label plurals: used a single non-pluralized 'Hodnotit {{stars}} hvězdičkami' / 'Rate {{stars}} stars' key (NO _one/_few/_other suffixes) because the parity test requires identical key sets across cs/en and Czech few/other suffixes would mismatch English. Also the star aria-label must NOT contain the total ('... z 5') or every radio's accessible name matches /5/ and getByRole('radio',{name:/5/}) becomes ambiguous — the label is the count only.
- mockRejectedValueOnce (not mockRejectedValue) for the 409/500 submit tests (the vitest-2 shared-rejected-promise unhandled-rejection trap from laneB4d).

All new i18n keys (customer.rating.*, customer.history.*) in BOTH cs.json + en.json (parity green), formal Czech 'vy'. Money integer CZK via formatCzk (Intl cs-CZ); timestamps Europe/Prague at render. Did NOT touch api/** or .claude/state/pipeline.json. Staged web/ only (tsconfig.tsbuildinfo, dist/, test-results/ excluded — verified).

Both green.
(2) StarPicker read-only branch: replaced the hardcoded '#f9ab00'/'#dadce0'/'22px' inline style with a styled ReadOnlyStar<{$filled}> using theme.colors.warning/border + fontSizeXl (web-react-style.md no-hardcoded-colors/magic-px).
(3) RatingForm canSubmit now gates on orderId != null (useRateOrder exposes orderId): if a completed order is not in page-1 of orders/mine (a customer with many newer orders opening an OLD completed order's URL directly), submit would silently no-op on an enabled button — now the button stays disabled. Realistic flows (live completion + history-tap) always hit page 1 so they are unaffected. Also added getMyOrderHistory to the TrackingPage.test mock set defensively (RatingForm mounts on authed+Completed and calls it).
